experiences and feedback with us by submitting a review. Your insights help us improve our products

providing you with the best support and solutions.

information you need.

## Support

### [Van Configurator][78]

Take control of your van's storage with our Van Configurator. This powerful tool lets you design a
storage solution that's perfectly tailored to your needs. Choose from a wide range of shelving,
drawers, and accessories to create a workspace that's both functional and efficient. Whether you're
a contractor, electrician, or plumber, our Van Configurator helps you make the most of your van's
storage potential. Be bold and fearless in your design – we provide the tools, and you bring the
vision.

### [Truck Fit Guide][79]

Discover the ideal WEATHER GUARD products for your truck with our Truck Fit Guide. This
comprehensive tool provides detailed information on which WEATHER GUARD products are compatible with
various truck models and sizes. From toolboxes to ladder racks, find the perfect fit to ensure
secure and organized storage of your tools and equipment. We offer clear guidance to help you make
wise decisions for your truck setup, ensuring you get the most out of your investment.

### [Submit a Review][80]

Have a WEATHER GUARD product that you use every day? We want to hear from you! Share your
experiences and feedback with us by submitting a review. Your insights help us improve our products
and services, and they also assist other customers in making informed decisions. Whether it's a
truck box, van storage system, or any other WEATHER GUARD product, your review is valuable to us. Be
unfiltered and honest – your voice matters.

### [Replacement Parts][81]

Need replacement parts for your WEATHER GUARD products? We've got you covered. Replacement parts for
WEATHER GUARD products are available through our network of authorized distributors and retailers.
Whether you need a new lock, hinge, or any other component, you can easily find and purchase the
parts you need to keep your equipment in top condition. We are unwavering in our commitment to
providing you with the best support and solutions.

### [FAQs][82]

Got questions about WEATHER GUARD products? Our comprehensive FAQ section has the answers. Whether
you're seeking information on product features, maintenance tips, or troubleshooting advice, our
FAQs provide quick and easy access to the details you need. If you can't find what you're looking
for, our customer support team is always ready to assist. We are driven to ensure you have all the
information you need.

### [Literature][83]

Easily access a wide range of catalogs, fitment guides, flyers, and product-specific literature. Our
literature section provides all the information you need about WEATHER GUARD products, including
detailed specifications, usage instructions, and safety guidelines. Stay informed and make the most
of your WEATHER GUARD equipment with our extensive library of resources.

### [Online Training][84]

Safety and proper usage are our top priorities. Access a variety of online training resources for
WEATHER GUARD Truck and Van Products. Our training programs are designed to help you understand the
proper use and maintenance of our products, ensuring that you stay safe on the job. From video
tutorials to interactive courses, we offer a range of training options to suit your needs.

### [Product Registration][85]

Register your WEATHER GUARD Truck Box here. By registering your product, you can ensure that you
receive important updates, warranty information, and support. It's a quick and easy way to stay
connected with WEATHER GUARD and get the most out of your investment.

American Tarping is a family-owned and operated distributor of truck tarp systems, motors, tarps,
and replacement parts. We carry high quality products at fair prices, and provide the highest level
of customer service in the industry. Our products cover the entire range of tarping system needs,
including electric, manual, side-mount, underbody, crank-and-pull style, side-roll, roll off
systems, and more. We also carry a wide assortment of motors, tarps, and replacement parts that work
interchangeably with major brands, including Mountain, Pioneer, USTarp, Roll-Rite, Donovan, Tarping
Systems Inc, etc. If you don't see what you need, contact us and we will find it for you, at a price
you won't find anywhere else. We look forward to serving you!

and replacement parts. We carry high quality products at fair prices, and provide the highest level
of customer service in the industry. Our products cover the entire range of tarping system needs,
including electric, manual, side-mount, underbody, crank-and-pull style, side-roll, roll off
systems, and more. We also carry a wide assortment of motors, tarps, and replacement parts that work
interchangeably with major brands, including Mountain, Pioneer, USTarp, Roll-Rite, Donovan, Tarping
Systems Inc, etc. If you don't see what you need, contact us and we will find it for you, at a price

## Sell vehicles together with Autoline!

Welcome to Autoline – the international marketplace for the sale of commercial vehicles!
Autoline is the leading online marketplace specializing in heavy commercial vehicles (trucks,
tractor units, buses, trailers, tankers, and other heavy machinery and spare parts).
It is a convenient platform where you can quickly, efficiently, and safely buy or sell special
machinery, as more than 1,400,000 users from 80 countries browse our pages every day in search of
the right product.
Security

We take great care to ensure that the portal is safe for both buyers and sellers. We have solid
experience in this area and invest a lot of time and resources in security.

How do I search?
The design of the website has been developed to make the search process as comfortable as possible:
many filters, the ability to compare and sort, add to favourites, and read reviews of the seller.
Navigation is simple, logical, and intuitive. Finding the truck you need is as easy as, for example,
a cell phone: search — compare — choose — buy — use.
Autoline offers a wide range of promotional services
* For individual ads
* For the business as a whole
About us

Autoline is represented in 80 countries on 5 continents.

We have been on the market for 24 years, during which time we have gained a lot of experience, built
up a broad base, and become professionals in the domain.

## North Texas Battle Motors Dealer since 1977

For over seven decades, Bond Equipment has been a cornerstone in the heavy-duty truck industry,
proudly serving the Dallas/Fort Worth area. Established in 1951, our family-owned business has built
a reputation for excellence in truck and trailer repairs, parts, and sales. As an authorized dealer
for renowned brands like Cummins, Warren, and Battle Motors, we are committed to providing top-tier
products and services to meet your vocational trucking needs.

[VIEW BATTLE MOTORS INVENTORY >][29]
[LEARN MORE ABOUT BOND >][30]
[Bond Equipment Logo.png]

Address: 2946 Irving Blvd, Dallas, TX 75247

Phone: (214) 637-0760

Email:  [info@bondequipment.com][31]

Hours

Repair Shop: M-F 5:00 AM - 3:00 PM CST

Parts Sales: M-F 7:00AM - 4:00 PM CST

## Introducing Battle Motors: Innovation Meets Durability

Bond Equipment is proud to be North Texas' authorized dealer for Battle Motors, a leader in the
vocational truck industry. Battle Motors specializes in manufacturing heavy-duty trucks powered by
diesel, compressed natural gas (CNG), and electric drivetrains. Their vehicles are engineered for
the most demanding applications, including refuse collection, construction, utility services, and
general freight. With a focus on sustainability and cutting-edge technology, Battle Motors is
redefining the future of vocational trucking.

#### Our Battle Motors Inventory: Ready for Any Challenge

At Bond Equipment, we offer a diverse selection of Battle Motors trucks designed to tackle various
vocational tasks

[SEE OUR TRUCKS >][32]


Equipped with Cummins X12 engines delivering 350 HP, Allison 4500 transmissions, and Witke Super
Duty 40-yard bodies, these trucks are built for heavy-duty performance.


Featuring Cummins L9 engines, 4500 RDS transmissions, and right-hand drive configurations, these
trucks are ideal for efficient refuse collection.


Our inventory is continually updated to meet the evolving needs of our clients.

## Comprehensive Services: Beyond Sales
* Bond Equipment is more than just a dealership;

we're your full-service partner in

vocational trucking:

* Our certified technicians specialize in a
  wide range of services, from engine rebuilds to the
  installation of wet line kits.

* We stock a vast selection of parts for
  various truck brands, ensuring quick
  turnaround times and minimal downtime.

* Understanding that each business has unique
  needs, we offer tailored solutions to optimize
  your fleet's performance.

SEE OUR SERVICES >

## Why Choose Bond Equipment?


#### Legacy of Excellence

With over 80 years of combined experience, our team delivers unparalleled expertise and customer
service


#### Strategic Partnerships

Our collaborations with industry leaders like Battle Motors and Cummins ensure access to the latest
technologies and innovations.


#### Customer-Centric Approach

We prioritize your business needs, offering flexible financing options and personalized support to
help you achieve your operational goals.

vocational truck industry. Battle Motors specializes in manufacturing heavy-duty trucks powered by

the most demanding applications, including refuse collection, construction, utility services, and
general freight. With a focus on sustainability and cutting-edge technology, Battle Motors is
redefining the future of vocational trucking.

#### Material Certification

All incoming steel and aluminum verified against mill certificates. Material thickness, grade, and

Critical dimensions checked at each production stage. Weld penetration, bend angles, and hole
positions verified.

Visual and non-destructive testing on all structural welds. Full penetration and absence of porosity
verified.

#### Dimensional Accuracy

Final products measured against CAD specs using precision instruments. Mounting points verified to

Export packaging tested to withstand ocean freight. Crush tests and drop tests ensure damage-free
delivery.

Complete inspection checklist before shipment. Quality reports and certificates prepared for each
batch.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our products, processes, and services.

MOQ Samples Lead Time Packaging Vehicle Fitment

#### What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

Our standard MOQ varies by product type: Moose Bumpers start at 50 units, Grille Guards at 100
units, and Tool Boxes at 200 units per order. For new OEM partnerships or custom designs, we can
discuss flexible arrangements during initial consultations. Volume discounts are available for
larger orders.

#### Can I order below the MOQ for trial purposes?

Yes, we offer sample orders for quality evaluation before committing to full MOQ. Sample quantities
typically range from 1-5 units depending on product complexity. Sample costs may be higher per unit
but are often credited back on subsequent bulk orders that meet our standard MOQ requirements.

#### How do you ensure sample-to-production consistency?

We use precision jigs and fixtures created during the sample phase for all production runs. CMM
verification ensures hole positions match approved samples. Our quality team conducts first-article
inspections and maintains detailed production control documents throughout the manufacturing
process.

#### What is the sample development cost?

Sample costs vary based on complexity and materials. Simple modifications to existing designs may
have minimal costs, while completely new designs require tooling investment. We provide detailed
cost breakdowns upfront, and sample costs are often credited back on production orders above certain
quantities.

#### What is the standard production lead time?

Standard production lead time is 25-35 days from order confirmation, depending on order quantity and
product complexity. Rush production (15-20 days) is available at additional cost when capacity
allows. We provide real-time production updates throughout the manufacturing process.

#### How long does shipping take to North America?

Sea freight to West Coast ports typically takes 15-20 days, and to East Coast ports 25-30 days. We
work with reliable freight forwarders and can arrange door-to-door delivery. Air freight options are
available for urgent shipments at additional cost.

#### What packaging options do you offer?

We offer multiple packaging options: standard export packaging with wooden crates, retail-ready
packaging with your branding, and custom packaging solutions. All packaging is tested to withstand
ocean freight conditions and includes protective padding to prevent damage during transit.

#### Can you add our logo and branding to packaging?

Yes, we provide full private labeling services including custom packaging with your logo, branded
instruction manuals, and product labels. We can match your existing brand guidelines or help develop
packaging designs for new product lines.

#### Which truck models do you support?

We manufacture products for most major North American truck brands including Freightliner,
Peterbilt, Kenworth, Volvo, Mack, International, and Western Star. For pickup guards, we cover Ford,
Chevrolet, GMC, RAM, and Toyota. Custom fitments for other makes and models can be developed upon
request.

#### How do you ensure proper vehicle fitment?

We maintain an extensive database of vehicle specifications and mounting points. For new
applications, we request detailed measurements or reference parts. All new designs undergo physical
test-fitting on actual vehicles before production approval to ensure bolt-on installation.

Still have questions? Our team is ready

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our products, processes, and services.

MOQ Samples Lead Time Packaging Vehicle Fitment

#### What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

Our standard MOQ varies by product type: Moose Bumpers start at 50 units, Grille Guards at 100
units, and Tool Boxes at 200 units per order. For new OEM partnerships or custom designs, we can
discuss flexible arrangements during initial consultations. Volume discounts are available for
larger orders.

#### Can I order below the MOQ for trial purposes?

Yes, we offer sample orders for quality evaluation before committing to full MOQ. Sample quantities
typically range from 1-5 units depending on product complexity. Sample costs may be higher per unit
but are often credited back on subsequent bulk orders that meet our standard MOQ requirements.

#### How do you ensure sample-to-production consistency?

We use precision jigs and fixtures created during the sample phase for all production runs. CMM
verification ensures hole positions match approved samples. Our quality team conducts first-article
inspections and maintains detailed production control documents throughout the manufacturing
process.

#### What is the sample development cost?

Sample costs vary based on complexity and materials. Simple modifications to existing designs may
have minimal costs, while completely new designs require tooling investment. We provide detailed
cost breakdowns upfront, and sample costs are often credited back on production orders above certain
quantities.

#### What is the standard production lead time?

Standard production lead time is 25-35 days from order confirmation, depending on order quantity and
product complexity. Rush production (15-20 days) is available at additional cost when capacity
allows. We provide real-time production updates throughout the manufacturing process.

#### How long does shipping take to North America?

Sea freight to West Coast ports typically takes 15-20 days, and to East Coast ports 25-30 days. We
work with reliable freight forwarders and can arrange door-to-door delivery. Air freight options are
available for urgent shipments at additional cost.

#### What packaging options do you offer?

We offer multiple packaging options: standard export packaging with wooden crates, retail-ready
packaging with your branding, and custom packaging solutions. All packaging is tested to withstand
ocean freight conditions and includes protective padding to prevent damage during transit.

#### Can you add our logo and branding to packaging?

Yes, we provide full private labeling services including custom packaging with your logo, branded
instruction manuals, and product labels. We can match your existing brand guidelines or help develop
packaging designs for new product lines.

#### Which truck models do you support?

We manufacture products for most major North American truck brands including Freightliner,
Peterbilt, Kenworth, Volvo, Mack, International, and Western Star. For pickup guards, we cover Ford,
Chevrolet, GMC, RAM, and Toyota. Custom fitments for other makes and models can be developed upon
request.

#### How do you ensure proper vehicle fitment?

We maintain an extensive database of vehicle specifications and mounting points. For new
applications, we request detailed measurements or reference parts. All new designs undergo physical
test-fitting on actual vehicles before production approval to ensure bolt-on installation.

Still have questions? Our team is ready

## Metal Cases, Metal Cabinets, Metal Enclosures, Metal Boxes & More. Bull Metal Has You Covered.

### MANUFACTURING SHEET METAL PRODUCTS

#### Custom Sheet Metal Enclosures

At Bull Metal Products Inc., we offer custom manufacturing solutions for sheet metal enclosures,
designed and constructed to the exact specifications of our customers' needs. We understand that
every application is unique, requiring enclosures designed and constructed to meet specific
operational conditions, size, configuration, and durability requirements.

[Sheet Metal Enclosures][20]

#### Assembly and Hardware Insertion

At Bull Metal Products, our commitment to providing integrated end-to-end sheet metal fabrication
solutions, including sheet metal assembly and hardware insertion, sets us apart. We have the
know-how, the technology, and the commitment to quality that makes us a leader in the manufacturing
of custom sheet metal products.

[Assembly & Hardware Insertion][21]

#### Powder Coating: Finish for Metal and Steel

Ever wondered how sheet metal products get their sleek, durable finish? The answer is Powder
Coating. We discuss what it is, its transformative usage and why it’s a preferred choice by
manufacturers for adding color, shine, and a touch of beauty alongside guaranteed longevity to
highly resilient metal and steel products.

[Powder Coating][22]

#### Screen Printing and Labeling

This article outlines the role of screen printing and labeling in sheet metal manufacturing. It
explains how these methods are used for logos, branding, labeling, ornamentation, schematics, and
instructions on products. Detailing each process and how these techniques improve the look of the
products and also enhance their usability and longevity.

[Screen Printing and Labeling][23]

#### Custom Configurations

Bull Metal Products offers a wide array of configuration options, allowing customers to tailor
dimensions, shelving, locking mechanisms, and finishes to precisely fit their storage needs and
aesthetic preferences.

[Configuration Options][24]

#### Choose a Mounting Style

For mounting solutions, Bull Metal Products provides versatile and robust options ranging from wall
mounting systems to free-standing and rack mounts, ensuring optimal placement and security for any
application.

[Mounting Options][25]

#### The Right Materials

The critical factors involved in selecting materials for sheet metal manufacturing, highlighting
considerations such as durability, corrosion resistance, and aesthetic appeal. The importance of
material characteristics, including those of steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and brass, in
ensuring the production of high-quality and cost-effective sheet metal products.

[Materials][26]

#### Considerations: Enclosure Design

This article outlines essential considerations for designing sheet metal enclosures, focusing on
aspects such as material selection, structural integrity, manufacturability, and compliance with
industry standards. By addressing these key factors, manufacturers like Bull Metal Products can
ensure their enclosures meet the highest standards of functionality, durability, and aesthetic
appeal.

[Designing an Enclosure][27]

# [Premier Trucking Company & Trucking Jobs in Missouri][59]

Welcome to Christenson Transportation, your trusted trucking company with locations in Springfield,
Missouri, and Lebanon, Tennessee. Founded in 1979 by Gene Christenson as a brokerage firm, our
family-owned company has evolved under the leadership of our current President, Don Christenson, who
established the trucking line in 1995. Today, Christenson Transportation operates across all
forty-eight states, specializing in the timely delivery of freight. With over 35 years of experience
in the trucking industry, we have been honored with the Truckload Carriers Association Safety Award
three times and recognized with the prestigious Platinum Fleet Award for “Outstanding Achievement in
Highway Traffic Safety.” In 2025, we were proudly voted as the Best to Drive in TCA's inaugural
Elite Fleet, a testament to our dedication to quality drivers and customer safety. As a proud member
of the Truckload Carriers Association and the Missouri Motor Carriers Association, Christenson
Transportation is committed to delivering exceptional value and reliability in every shipment.
Choose our trucking company for your transportation needs, and experience our commitment to
excellence firsthand.

[Learn more][60]

## DRIVE FOR US!

Join our fleet of skilled truck drivers and experience the open road like never before. With
competitive pay, top-of-the-line equipment, and a supportive team, we're the perfect fit for your
next career move.

[Christenson Owner Operator Jobs]
[MaxFleetLogo_edited.jpg]

### LEASE-PURCHASE PROGRAM

Leasing a quality tractor is easy and it’s the first step to becoming an owner-operator. At
Christenson Transportation, we want to help our operators obtain and drive the truck of their
dreams! If you’re ready to start your journey with Christenson, [view our application here][61].
Still, have questions? 

[CONTACT US][62]

### OWNER OPERATORS

Join the Christenson team and bring your own truck! We are committed to helping you achieve your
desired success in the trucking industry.

[FIND OUT MORE...][63]

### EXPRESS FLEET - POWER ONLY PROGRAM

Manage your trucking operation with ease through our Elite Fleet Power-Only Program. Tailored for
your unique challenges, it provides the tools and support you need to boost profits. Join us for
agility, freedom, and the empowerment to take control of your business.

[FIND OUT MORE][64]

# [Premier Trucking Company & Trucking Jobs in Missouri][59]

Welcome to Christenson Transportation, your trusted trucking company with locations in Springfield,
Missouri, and Lebanon, Tennessee. Founded in 1979 by Gene Christenson as a brokerage firm, our
family-owned company has evolved under the leadership of our current President, Don Christenson, who
established the trucking line in 1995. Today, Christenson Transportation operates across all
forty-eight states, specializing in the timely delivery of freight. With over 35 years of experience
in the trucking industry, we have been honored with the Truckload Carriers Association Safety Award
three times and recognized with the prestigious Platinum Fleet Award for “Outstanding Achievement in
Highway Traffic Safety.” In 2025, we were proudly voted as the Best to Drive in TCA's inaugural
Elite Fleet, a testament to our dedication to quality drivers and customer safety. As a proud member
of the Truckload Carriers Association and the Missouri Motor Carriers Association, Christenson
Transportation is committed to delivering exceptional value and reliability in every shipment.
Choose our trucking company for your transportation needs, and experience our commitment to
excellence firsthand.

[Learn more][60]

## DRIVE FOR US!

Join our fleet of skilled truck drivers and experience the open road like never before. With
competitive pay, top-of-the-line equipment, and a supportive team, we're the perfect fit for your
next career move.

[Christenson Owner Operator Jobs]
[MaxFleetLogo_edited.jpg]

### LEASE-PURCHASE PROGRAM

Leasing a quality tractor is easy and it’s the first step to becoming an owner-operator. At
Christenson Transportation, we want to help our operators obtain and drive the truck of their
dreams! If you’re ready to start your journey with Christenson, [view our application here][61].
Still, have questions? 

[CONTACT US][62]

### OWNER OPERATORS

Join the Christenson team and bring your own truck! We are committed to helping you achieve your
desired success in the trucking industry.

[FIND OUT MORE...][63]

### EXPRESS FLEET - POWER ONLY PROGRAM

Manage your trucking operation with ease through our Elite Fleet Power-Only Program. Tailored for
your unique challenges, it provides the tools and support you need to boost profits. Join us for

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

# Free Online Games at CrazyGames

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

## About CrazyGames

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

## Play our Best Games

CrazyGames has over 4,500 fun games in every genre you can imagine. Some of our most popular games
are:
* [Shell Shockers][69]
* [Agar io][70]
* [Uno Online][71]
* [Geometry Dash][72]
* [Moto X3M][73]
* [Smash Karts][74]
* [GeoGuessr][75]
* [Hangman][76]

## Explore by Genre

You’ll find the main categories like [clicker][77], [driving games][78], and [shooting games][79] at
the top of any page, but there’s also a range of subcategories that will help you find the perfect
game. Popular tags include [car games][80], [Minecraft][81], [2-player games][82], [match 3
games][83], and [mahjong.][84]

## Suggest a Game

Is there a game that you love, but you can't find on CrazyGames? [Suggest a game][85] to us, and
we'll see what we can do to get it. You can also [contact us][86] for any general suggestions or
improvements.

## About CrazyGames

CrazyGames is a free browser gaming platform founded in 2014 by Raf Mertens. Since then, the
platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

Our mission is simple: to create a browser-gaming platform that works seamlessly for users around
the world and rewards developers both big and small. Visit our corporate site and learn more [about
CrazyGames][87].

### Enhance Your Vehicle With Evolution Coatings and Automotive Upfitting

Evolution Coatings and Automotive Upfitting is here to upgrade your vehicle. Since 2007, we've been
the go-to place for drivers who want their cars and trucks to look great and stay protected. With 18
years of experience, we've built a reputation for excellent service and quality work, whether you
need lift kits or truck upfitting in Troy, OH.



At Evolution Coatings, we believe your vehicle should do more than get you from one place to
another—it should reflect your lifestyle, priorities, and pride of ownership. Our mission is to help
you achieve that balance of protection, performance, and personal style through high-quality
coatings and custom upgrades. Whether you’re preserving a new paint job or enhancing your truck’s
capability, we bring craftsmanship and care to every project.



Our process begins with advanced protective solutions designed to keep your vehicle in top condition
for years to come. From durable ceramic coatings that add long-lasting shine to professional
rustproofing and undercoating that defend against Ohio’s harsh weather, we make protection a
priority. When it’s time to add function and flair, we offer a wide range of accessories and
services like truck upfitting in Bellefontaine, OH, that complement both your vehicle’s appearance
and your driving needs.



We understand that customization means something different for every driver. Some customers want to
outfit their trucks for work performance, while others want eye-catching upgrades for weekend
adventures. That’s why we take the time to learn what you need before recommending solutions. Our
shop offers durable and stylish truck accessories and services like truck upfitting in Troy, OH. You
can come to us for anything from bed liners and storage options to lighting, bumpers, and more—all
installed with precision and care.



Every service we offer is built on the idea that your vehicle deserves the same level of attention
you give to its performance. We’re here to help you protect, upgrade, and personalize your
investment so it can serve you for years to come. For those looking for functional add-ons or
performance-enhancing upgrades, our truck accessories and truck upfitting services in Bellefontaine,
OH, provide both reliability and a custom look that stands out on any road.



If you’ve ever tried a do-it-yourself coating kit, you already know the results can vary—sometimes
dramatically. While DIY options might seem convenient, the difference between store-bought products
and a professional-grade coating service is far more than just technique. At Evolution Coatings, we
apply industry-grade materials with the right tools, environment, and expertise to achieve lasting
protection and a flawless finish. The goal isn’t just to make your vehicle shine today—it’s to
preserve that look and safeguard your investment for years to come.



One of the biggest distinctions lies in surface preparation. Professional coating involves deep
cleaning, decontamination, and precision polishing to remove every imperfection before the coating
is applied. A DIY job can’t replicate that level of preparation, which often leads to uneven
application or premature wear. When our customers come in for services like ceramic coatings,
undercoating, or truck upfitting in Bellefontaine, OH, they’re getting more than a quick fix—they’re
getting a complete protection and customization experience tailored to their vehicle.



Quality coatings also require controlled environments. Temperature, humidity, and curing times all
affect how a coating bonds to your vehicle’s surface. At-home projects simply can’t match the
conditions or curing methods used in a professional setting. When combined with our durable and
stylish truck accessories and services like truck upfitting in Troy, OH, a professionally coated
vehicle not only looks stunning but also resists fading, corrosion, and road damage more
effectively.



Beyond performance, professional coatings save time and money in the long run. DIY products often
need reapplication after a few months, while our professional coatings can last for years with
proper care. We’ve seen many vehicle owners upgrade from a temporary DIY solution to a long-term
protective finish that brings out the best in their car or truck. For those adding truck accessories
or investing in truck upfitting in Bellefontaine, OH, a professionally applied coating enhances
every detail—making colors pop and surfaces easier to clean.


What makes us different? We're leaders in ValuGard installation, offering a nationwide lifetime
warranty for your peace of mind. Our owner is always present, making sure every job meets our high
standards. Our store is clean and welcoming, and we specialize in custom work that makes your
vehicle unique. Whether you want to improve your truck, add style to your car, or keep your vehicle
in great shape, we're here to help. [Visit us][105] today!

Evolution Coatings and Automotive Upfitting is here to upgrade your vehicle. Since 2007, we've been
the go-to place for drivers who want their cars and trucks to look great and stay protected. With 18

At Evolution Coatings, we believe your vehicle should do more than get you from one place to
another—it should reflect your lifestyle, priorities, and pride of ownership. Our mission is to help

can come to us for anything from bed liners and storage options to lighting, bumpers, and more—all

performance-enhancing upgrades, our truck accessories and truck upfitting services in Bellefontaine,

apply industry-grade materials with the right tools, environment, and expertise to achieve lasting
protection and a flawless finish. The goal isn’t just to make your vehicle shine today—it’s to
preserve that look and safeguard your investment for years to come.



One of the biggest distinctions lies in surface preparation. Professional coating involves deep
cleaning, decontamination, and precision polishing to remove every imperfection before the coating
is applied. A DIY job can’t replicate that level of preparation, which often leads to uneven
application or premature wear. When our customers come in for services like ceramic coatings,
undercoating, or truck upfitting in Bellefontaine, OH, they’re getting more than a quick fix—they’re
getting a complete protection and customization experience tailored to their vehicle.



Quality coatings also require controlled environments. Temperature, humidity, and curing times all
affect how a coating bonds to your vehicle’s surface. At-home projects simply can’t match the
conditions or curing methods used in a professional setting. When combined with our durable and
stylish truck accessories and services like truck upfitting in Troy, OH, a professionally coated
vehicle not only looks stunning but also resists fading, corrosion, and road damage more
effectively.



Beyond performance, professional coatings save time and money in the long run. DIY products often
need reapplication after a few months, while our professional coatings can last for years with
proper care. We’ve seen many vehicle owners upgrade from a temporary DIY solution to a long-term

or investing in truck upfitting in Bellefontaine, OH, a professionally applied coating enhances
every detail—making colors pop and surfaces easier to clean.

System One® manufactures high quality aluminum ladder racks, truck tool boxes, and drawers for
pick-up trucks and vans in a variety of configurations. These ladder racks and accessories are used
by contractors, utility companies, the military and other government agencies and are built entirely
from aluminum alloy and stainless steel for a long, hard life in some of the most challenging
construction environments to be found anywhere. Our truck racks and van racks are without a doubt
the best engineered ladder racks available.  Our innovative Work Winch® is made to secure overhead
cargo efficiently and safely and is the only rust-free Integrated Tie-down System made.

Unlike heavier steel ladder racks, aluminum ladder racks deliver rust-free strength and light
weight, which means you enjoy an attractive no-maintenence appearance and the reduced weight gives
you greater fuel efficiency.  Aluminum ladder racks are more tolerant of scratching and the kind of
abuse that usually spells the end of most steel racks.  Steel ladder racks become either a constant
maintenance headache or continue to deteriorate until you lose your investment completely. 

Among aluminum ladder racks for contractor trucks, System One®  stands out.  When you purchase a
System One® ladder rack, Full Access® truck tool boxes or StowAway™ drawers, you make an investment
in solid equipment which will ultimately save you money.  Made entirely of high-strength aluminum
alloy with stainless steel hardware, your System One® ladder rack has a virtually unlimited lifespan
and will pay for itself many times over. In fact, many people move their System One® truck rack and
truck tool boxes from truck to truck as the years go by.

System One® manufactures high quality aluminum ladder racks, truck tool boxes, and drawers for
pick-up trucks and vans in a variety of configurations. These ladder racks and accessories are used
by contractors, utility companies, the military and other government agencies and are built entirely
from aluminum alloy and stainless steel for a long, hard life in some of the most challenging
construction environments to be found anywhere. Our truck racks and van racks are without a doubt
the best engineered ladder racks available.  Our innovative Work Winch® is made to secure overhead
cargo efficiently and safely and is the only rust-free Integrated Tie-down System made.

Unlike heavier steel ladder racks, aluminum ladder racks deliver rust-free strength and light
weight, which means you enjoy an attractive no-maintenence appearance and the reduced weight gives
you greater fuel efficiency.  Aluminum ladder racks are more tolerant of scratching and the kind of
abuse that usually spells the end of most steel racks.  Steel ladder racks become either a constant
maintenance headache or continue to deteriorate until you lose your investment completely. 

Among aluminum ladder racks for contractor trucks, System One®  stands out.  When you purchase a
System One® ladder rack, Full Access® truck tool boxes or StowAway™ drawers, you make an investment
in solid equipment which will ultimately save you money.  Made entirely of high-strength aluminum
alloy with stainless steel hardware, your System One® ladder rack has a virtually unlimited lifespan
and will pay for itself many times over. In fact, many people move their System One® truck rack and
truck tool boxes from truck to truck as the years go by.

Our Full Access® truck tool boxes are constructed from .100” bright aluminum diamond tread plate,
3/16” (.188”) cast aluminum ends, and 3/4" stainless steel pivot pins set in bronze bearings, The
pivoting lid design provides complete accessibility to an interior that offers unique storage and
organization options. Organization means efficiency and efficiency means money, and that’s crucial
in today’s competitive business environment. Full Access® truck tool boxes are the toughest and
heaviest aluminum truck boxes made anywhere. Add our StowAway™ Drawers and you have a system for
storage and organization that surpasses all others.

This is what makes System One® equipment such an outstanding value.

Please have a look at our equipment and compare it to others. We think you'll be impressed.

# Lund Toolboxes Manufacturer

Built tough for the hard-working truck owner, Lund Toolboxes combine rugged construction with smart
design to keep your gear secure and organized. Crafted from heavy-duty aluminum, their deep-well and
crossover styles deliver unmatched strength and weather resistance. With sleek finishes and
theft-resistant features, Lund keeps your tools safe while adding a professional edge to your truck
bed. Decades of experience fuel their innovation, making Lund a trusted name for reliable, durable
storage solutions.

## Top Lund Toolboxes

### Lund 9436T 36-Inch Aluminum Flush Mount Single Lid Truck Tool Box, Diamond Plated, Silver

A sleek, low-profile design that fits snugly against the bed wall, providing secure storage without
obstructing rear visibility.

[ Check Price ][4]

### Lund 9352 Ultima Gull Wing Crossover Tool Box

Features dual gull-wing lids with gas struts for easy access and a portable aluminum tool tray for
added convenience.

[ Check Price ][5]

### Lund 76130 30-Inch Underbody Truck Tool Box, Black Steel

A compact, side-mounted box that offers rugged, weather-resistant storage without compromising bed
space.

[ Check Price ][6]

Discover the ultimate blend of durability and style with Lund Toolboxes and automotive accessories
designed to elevate your vehicle’s functionality.


## Crossover Truck Tool Boxes

Crossover truck tool boxes offer a sleek, secure storage solution that fits snugly behind your
truck’s cab, making them perfect for easy access and maximizing bed space.

## Underbed Truck Tool Boxes

Underbed truck tool boxes are designed to fit beneath your truck bed, providing weatherproof and
out-of-the-way storage for tools and gear, ideal for keeping your truck organized without
sacrificing space.

## Side Mounted Truck Tool Boxes

Side mounted truck tool boxes attach directly to the side of your truck bed, delivering convenient,
accessible storage that’s great for quick tool retrieval and added utility.

## Storage Boxes and Toolboxes

Lund’s storage boxes and toolboxes come in a variety of sizes and materials, offering versatile,
durable solutions to keep your equipment protected and organized whether on the job or off-road.

### Customer Reviews

**Michael Anderson**
I’ve been using a Lund crossover truck toolbox for over two years now, and it has completely changed
how I manage my tools on the job. The build quality is outstanding, and it’s held up beautifully
against harsh weather and rough terrain. Installation was straightforward, and I appreciate the
sleek look it adds to my truck bed. Highly recommend for anyone needing durable, reliable storage!

**Jessica Martinez**

PRODUCT VIDEOS & TESTIMONIALS:
[Respect The Driver] [A brief history]

Minimizer products are Tested and Tortured in the most extreme conditions by the most demanding
workers in the toughest industry. We’re known for the off-the-charts testing we put our products
through. At Minimizer, ‘Tested and Tortured’ is more than just our brand, it’s standard operating
procedure. It’s what allows us to offer an unheard of lifetime guarantee!

Minimizer is the aftermarket solution for the heavy truck industry, whether you’re a driver,
owner/operator, fleet manager or technician. We invented the poly fender but didn’t stop there.
Innovation is the name of our game. Over the last three decades, we’ve also released dozens of
custom molded floor mats, slick plates, tool boxes, and our exclusive Long Haul Series mattresses.

With decades of experience and over a million units sold (most still in service today), Minimizer
products are proven where it matters most: on semi trucks and trailers just like yours. All of our
products are available nationally thanks to our distribution system with thousands of locations
throughout the U.S., Canada, LATAM and Mexico.

# PRODUTTORI DI CASSETTE PORTA ATTREZZI E TANICHE IN ACCIAIO INOX

## Parafancar è specializzata nella produzione standard e speciale di cassette porta attrezzi,
## taniche acqua, accessori e supporti vari per camion in acciaio inox.
## Comfort, sicurezza ed estetica in un solo prodotto.

[50 anni storia parafancar]

#### 50 anni di storia

Parafancar è nata nel 1968 per la produzione di parafanghi camion interamente lavorati a mano.

[Made in Italy]

#### Made in Italy

Gestiamo tutto il ciclo produttivo nella sede di Brescia e contiamo sul personale altamente
qualificato.

[Al tuo servizio]

#### Al tuo servizio

I nostri prodotti sono sempre personalizzabili in dimensioni, finiture e dotazioni.

[rating di legalità]

#### Rating di Legalità

Riconoscimento del nostro impegno a trasparenza, correttezza e crescita responsabile.

[

## Cassette porta utensili

Scopri la nostra gamma di **cassette porta utensili per camion**, realizzate con materiali di alta
qualità per offrire una protezione robusta e duratura ai tuoi attrezzi. Come produttori di cassette
porta attrezzi, garantiamo soluzioni personalizzate in acciaio inox lucido o fiorettato, acciaio
zincato, resistenti alla corrosione e agli agenti atmosferici. Le nostre cassette porta utensili
hanno spessori diversi, da 0,8 a 1,5 mm, con saldatura TIG certificata.

[Cassette porta utensili per camion]
][33] [
[Taniche lavamano per camion]

## Taniche acciaio inox

Scopri la nostra gamma completa di **taniche lavamano per camion**, progettate per offrire praticità
e igiene in ogni situazione. Come produttori di taniche, in acciaio inox o in robusto PVC,
realizziamo soluzioni con varie tipologie di attacco e capacità. Offriamo inoltre *taniche su misura
basate su disegni dei clienti*, garantendo una perfetta integrazione con il vostro veicolo e le
vostre esigenze specifiche.

][34]

### Cassetta porta attrezzi EUROPA

##### Per ogni applicazione

Progettata e prodotta in Italia, è disponibile di qualunque misura e con infinite possibilità di
personalizzazioni.

## Comfort, sicurezza ed estetica in un solo prodotto.

[50 anni storia parafancar]

#### 50 anni di storia

Parafancar è nata nel 1968 per la produzione di parafanghi camion interamente lavorati a mano.

[Made in Italy]

Gestiamo tutto il ciclo produttivo nella sede di Brescia e contiamo sul personale altamente
qualificato.

[Al tuo servizio]

[

## Cassette porta utensili

Scopri la nostra gamma di **cassette porta utensili per camion**, realizzate con materiali di alta
qualità per offrire una protezione robusta e duratura ai tuoi attrezzi. Come produttori di cassette
porta attrezzi, garantiamo soluzioni personalizzate in acciaio inox lucido o fiorettato, acciaio
zincato, resistenti alla corrosione e agli agenti atmosferici. Le nostre cassette porta utensili
hanno spessori diversi, da 0,8 a 1,5 mm, con saldatura TIG certificata.

realizziamo soluzioni con varie tipologie di attacco e capacità. Offriamo inoltre *taniche su misura
basate su disegni dei clienti*, garantendo una perfetta integrazione con il vostro veicolo e le
vostre esigenze specifiche.

### **Help you maintain FSMA help maintain food safety**

FSMA, or the Food Safety Modernization Act, has specific guidelines that apply to businesses that
transport food within the U.S. According to these new rules, businesses must ensure that the
compartments in their vehicles that the food is held in are properly pre-cooled and cleaned. They
also need to be able to prove that they have maintained temperature conditions during transport.

Below are a few important products to help you in your journey to FSMA compliance.
* IsoTemp system
* IsoChem system
* Professionally sized reefer units

#### Over $900 average savings for new customers who save^{*}

With Progressive auto insurance, you'll enjoy affordable coverage options and a variety of
discounts. Plus, you can get a quote in just a few minutes – get started now and enjoy peace of mind
behind the wheel.

**Why Progressive?:** We guarantee repairs for as long as you own or lease your vehicle when you
take it to one of our network shops.

[Learn more about auto][32]

#### Bundle property and save an average of 5% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

Simply quote auto and homeowners insurance and you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ} Plus,
with both policies under one roof, you can update or make changes to your insurance with ease. Quote
now to get started.

[Learn more about bundling][33]

#### Quote now & get covered for as low as $100/year^{**}

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

[Learn more about boat][34]

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][37]

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][42]

#### Pet insurance

Affordable coverage for your four-legged friend

With Progressive Pet Insurance by Pets Best, you can create a plan that fits your dog or cat's
needs, as well as your budget. Simply choose a plan and then customize your deductible,
reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

#### Protect yourself from damage, theft, and more

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help
pay for your temporary living expenses. Get covered today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

#### Join a leading RV insurer starting at $125/year^{††}

Whether you're a full-time RVer or an occasional road-tripper, you'll find all the coverages you
need at an affordable price right here. Get a quote now and enjoy the open road without worry.

**Why Progressive?:** From windshield & glass coverage to emergency expenses, we have your road trip
covered.

[Learn more about RV][45]

#### Umbrella insurance

Extra coverage for all your assets

Umbrella insurance provides an extra layer of liability coverage beyond what your home and auto
policy offer, with limits available up to $5 million.

[Learn more about umbrella insurance][46]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][47]

#### Bundle and save an average of 7% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

Simply quote auto and homeowners insurance and you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ} Plus,
with both policies under one roof, you can update or make changes to your insurance with ease. Quote
now to get started.

[Learn more about bundling][48]

#### Bundle and save an average of 7% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

When you combine Progressive auto and condo insurance, you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ}
And with those extra savings comes the convenience of managing both your policies through one
company. Quote now to see the savings.

[Learn more about bundling][49]

#### Bundle and save an average of 3% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

With both an auto and renters policy, you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ} Plus, you'll enjoy
the convenience of having both policies under the same roof. Quote now to enjoy the extra savings
and ease of bundled insurance.

[Learn more about bundling][50]

## THE ALL-NEW RAM 1500 RUMBLE BEE

Iconic style paired with incredible speed. The All-New Ram 1500 Rumble Bee is ready to show the
world what a true muscle truck can do. Projected availability starting late 2026 depending on model.

[Learn More][59][Play Video][60]

## THE AWARD SAYS DEPENDABLE. THE WARRANTY SAYS WE MEAN IT.

The name behind America's Most Dependable Full-Size Truck is the same name behind America's Best
Full-Size Truck Powertrain Limited Warranty. 10 years or 100,000 miles on select 2026 Ram trucks and
vans.

[Explore Warranties][61]

### THE RIGHT FIT FOR THE WAY YOU WORK

Made for both cargo and crew, the All-New 2027 Ram ProMaster City^{®} is streets ahead of previous
models. It’s manueverable, efficient and can be easily customized to fit your business needs. Coming
early 2027.
[ Explore Ram ProMaster City® Explore Ram ProMaster City® ][62]

### POWER WAGON® GOES DIESEL

It’s always had brawn, and now it has even more bite. The Ram 2500 Power Wagon^{®} with an available
Diesel Engine option is stacked with:

· High-Output 6.7L Cummins^{®} Turbo Diesel I6 Engine
· Class-Exclusive Electronic Front Sway Bar Disconnect
· Front (Class-Exclusive) and Rear Electronic Locking Front Differentia
· Best-in-Class 1,075 Pound-Feet of Available Base Diesel Torque
· Bilstein^{®} Shock System
· Hill Descent Control
· Sport Performance Hood
· Rock Rails
· Goodyear All-Terrain Tires
[ sign-up-for-updates Sign Up For Updates ][63]
* ,
  [Explore Roush(Open in a new window)][64]
  ,

## DISCOVER NEW SPECIAL EDITIONS DISCOVER NEW SPECIAL EDITIONS

Distinct by design, Ram special edition vehicles are always ready to turn heads.
* [Three 2026 Ram trucks parked side-by-side on an outcropping in the desert. From left to right; a
  red Ram 1500 Rebel 4x4 Crew Cab, a white Ram 1500 Laramie 4x4 Crew Cab and a blue Ram 1500 Big
  Horn 4x4 Crew Cab. Proud Partner Of America 250. Built By Dreamers.]
  
  ## AMERICA 250th ANNIVERSARY EDITIONS
  
  ,
  
  Commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence with a truck
  that parades patriotic pride. Available on 2026 Ram 1500 Big Horn®, Laramie® and Rebel® models.
  Limited units available.
  
  ,
  * Exclusive America 250th Anniversary Decals and Badges
  * Choice of Molten Red, Bright White and Hydro Blue Exterior Colors
  * Sport Performance Hood
  * Unique Painted Black Bumpers and Wheel Flares
  * Red Seat Belts and Unique Red, White and Blue Interior Stitching
  * Denim Soul Fabric Seats (Big Horn® Models)
  * Leather-Trimmed Performance Seats with Blue Inserts (Laramie® and Rebel® Models)
  * Mopar® Spray-In Bedliner
  ,
  [Find a Dealer][65]
  ,

### THE TEAM IS LOCKED IN

Our roster is set and it’s stacked. Ram trucks are back in the NASCAR^{®} Craftsman Truck Series
with a racing team that’s ready to rule the 2026 season.

[Explore Ram Racing][66]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Shop-N-Box™?

Shop-N-Box™ builds patented roll-out truck toolbox organization systems that bring your tools to
you—fast. The system combines full roll-out access, repeatable tool organization, and rugged,
rough-road-ready construction for daily commercial use.

Who is Shop-N-Box™ built for?

Shop-N-Box™ is built for professionals who need fast tool access and consistent organization from a
truck—especially in demanding conditions. Common users include oil & gas crews, fleet managers,
contractors and trades, farmers/ranchers, mechanics, electricians, and utility teams.

How is Shop-N-Box™ different from a standard toolbox?

A standard toolbox is mostly reach-in storage—you dig for what you need. Shop-N-Box™ is a roll-out
tool organization system: tools stay visible, consistently placed, and easy to grab, with a patented
roller mechanism designed for rough roads and heavy daily use.

Is Shop-N-Box™ a service bed, a flatbed, or a toolbox system?

Shop-N-Box™ is a toolbox system that's offered in multiple formats—like truck bed systems (e.g.,
Legend Bed), flatbed solutions, and fleetside toolbox options. The common thread is the same:
roll-out access + organized inserts + rugged performance.

How does the patented roller system work?

Shop-N-Box™ uses a patented roller mechanism that supports a heavy-duty roll-out tray/drawer so your
tools roll out to you instead of being buried in the truck bed. It's built for daily use with rugged
components and a 10-gauge steel roll-out floor on applicable models.

Why is it better than cabinet slides on rough roads?

Cabinet-style slides are built for lighter loads and smoother environments, so rough roads and heavy
tools can cause binding, wear, or failure over time. Shop-N-Box's patented roller system is
engineered specifically for jobsite abuse, vibration, and uneven terrain, helping maintain smoother
operation and reliability.

What does "modular inserts" mean?

Modular inserts are swappable organization layouts inside the roll-out system. Instead of being
stuck with one permanent setup, you can choose inserts that match your work—so the toolbox stays
organized as your tools and jobs change.

What tools can the organizer insert hold?

Depending on the model and insert configuration, the organizer insert can store core hand tools in
dedicated positions, including: up to 90 sockets in some models, SAE wrench sets up to 1 ⅛", metric
wrench sets up to 25 MM, bolt bins, up to 50 screw & nut drivers, and miscellaneous storage (towel
rack). Capacity varies by model and insert configuration.

How do I get pricing / request a quote?

Shop-N-Box™ is quote-only so each build matches your truck and storage needs. Use the Request a
Quote form or call the team, share your vehicle/application and preferred product, and you'll get a
tailored recommendation and pricing.

Can Shop-N-Box™ outfit fleets with standardized layouts?

Yes. Shop-N-Box™ can outfit fleets with consistent, repeatable tool layouts across multiple trucks.
Standardization helps reduce downtime, improve accountability, speed up training, and simplify
inventory control—especially for service and field teams.

Welded receiver tubes for vices, grinders, and more. Swap accessories fast and clear your workspace

Built-in fork channels on every workbench make moving your setup fast, clean, and effortless.

Our hot-rolled plate steel tops come in 1/4" to 1" thick, so you get the exact strength and rigidity
your work demands.

Why Choose Us

# Our Tool Boxes Are Built To Last!

1.

### [Trebor’s Rapid Aluminum Truck Box Delivery: Get Your Tool Box in Days, Not Weeks][69]

What sets us apart at Trebor is our fast turnaround time between an order request and the delivery
of our aluminum truck boxes. You can expect your new tool box in a matter of days, not weeks. We
know how important that is to our customers.
2.

### [Trebor’s Rustproof Aluminum Truck Boxes: Conquer Water and Corrosion][70]

An important concern about purchasing a truck storage box is its resistance to water and rusting.
Trebor aluminum tool boxes are rustproof, light, and properly sealed along all seams and corners for
maximum protection. Our compression handles ensures proper door closure and all our lids are
installed with stainless steel hinges. No water, no rust.
3.

### [Customize Your Truck Storage Solution with Trebor’s Semi-Truck Tool Boxes][71]

All our semi-truck tool boxes have multiple custom options and come in any custom sizes. You can
even draw the truck box you have in mind and we will build it for you. Use our custom interactive
form to build your own underbody tool box, or discover Trebor’s standard tool boxes for trailers and
ask for custom options.
4.

### [Trebor’s Aluminum Truck Boxes: Built for the Rigors of the Road][72]

Our aluminum truck boxes are designed to endure the wear and tear of a life on the road. Built with
1/8″ aluminum thick material, heavy duty stainless steel 5″ hinges, and stainless steel handles
together with our lids, nothing compares to Trebor’s aluminum tool boxes.

# Custom Truck Tool Boxes Truck Bed Storage & Drawers - Built to Last

## Premium Truck Bed Storage Solutions Designed for Work

When your livelihood depends on having the right tools at the right time, you need a truck tool box
that works as hard as you do. At Truck Tool Box, we design and build custom truck tool boxes, truck
bed storage systems, and heavy-duty truck drawers engineered for durability, security, and
organization. Every toolbox is built with quality craftsmanship and backed by an industry-leading
10-year warranty.

Whether you're a contractor, electrician, plumber, mechanic, farmer, or fleet operator, our custom
storage solutions help you maximize truck bed space while keeping your equipment protected from
weather, theft, and daily wear and tear.

## Custom Truck Tool Boxes for Every Application

No two jobs are alike, and neither are our tool boxes. We specialize in custom-built truck storage
systems tailored to your specific needs. From truck bed drawers and side-mounted tool boxes to
specialty storage compartments and work truck organization systems, we create solutions that improve
efficiency and keep your tools within easy reach.

Our custom truck tool boxes are designed to:
* Maximize storage capacity
* Improve jobsite organization
* Protect valuable tools and equipment
* Reduce clutter and wasted space
* Increase productivity on the road and on the job

## Built for Durability. Engineered for Performance.

We understand that truck tool boxes face harsh conditions every day. That's why we build our storage
systems using high-quality materials and proven construction techniques designed to withstand
demanding work environments.

Our tool boxes are built to handle:
* Heavy daily use
* Extreme weather conditions
* Rugged job sites
* Commercial and industrial applications
* Long-term fleet service

When you invest in a Truck Tool Box storage solution, you're investing in years of dependable
performance.

## Custom Truck Bed Drawers & Storage Systems

Our truck bed drawer systems provide secure, organized storage while allowing easy access to tools,
equipment, and supplies. Eliminate the frustration of climbing into your truck bed or digging
through piles of gear.

## Chongqing Wholechaintech Automotive Components Co., Ltd.

[**Wholechaintech**][167] - officially Chongqing Wholechaintech Automotive Components Co., Ltd. - is
a professional specialized [**truck body & trailer**][168] manufacturer and factory in China,
located in the Liangjiang New Area Industrial Park, Chongqing.
Established in 2016, we are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the design, manufacturing, sales,
and after-sales service of truck bodies and multi-application trailers, along with their core
modification components.
As an experienced van truck body manufacturer and supplier in China, Wholechaintech integrates R&D,
production, system assembly, and technical service to provide complete vehicle solutions for
domestic and global customers. With strong engineering capabilities and an expanding international
footprint, we are committed to delivering reliable, safe, and cost-effective vehicle systems.

[**Wholechaintech**][167] - officially Chongqing Wholechaintech Automotive Components Co., Ltd. - is
a professional specialized [**truck body & trailer**][168] manufacturer and factory in China,
located in the Liangjiang New Area Industrial Park, Chongqing.
Established in 2016, we are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the design, manufacturing, sales,
and after-sales service of truck bodies and multi-application trailers, along with their core
modification components.
As an experienced van truck body manufacturer and supplier in China, Wholechaintech integrates R&D,
production, system assembly, and technical service to provide complete vehicle solutions for
domestic and global customers. With strong engineering capabilities and an expanding international
footprint, we are committed to delivering reliable, safe, and cost-effective vehicle systems.
